## Why This Is Asked

Advanced edge inference with open-set handling is realistic for on-site processing and catalog integration. It tests both CV skills and data engineering with a MongoDB-backed catalog, plus incremental learning in a streaming setting.

## Why This Is Asked

## Key Concepts
- On-device adaptation with limited shots
- Occlusion-robust 6-DoF pose estimation

- Domain randomization for synthetic-real transfer

## Code Example
```python
# Pseudo-code: adapter layer for 5-shot on-device fine-tuning
class AdapterHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, base_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.delta = nn.Linear(base_dim, base_dim)
    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.delta(x)
```
